provenance.decision: Per-host plugin shells (user decision 2026-06-12): AlembicCodex repo is Codex-only; this repo owns the Claude Code plugin.
provenance.initialContent: Functional artifacts (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, bin/, skills/, LICENSE) are byte-identical copies of the CC1-verified AlembicCodex shell commit 05802b1, which passed claude plugin validate --strict and a live scratch-profile load (5 skills, stdio MCP, 26 tools).
provenance.syncRule: Shared functional content (bin/ bootstrap, skill bodies, runtime pin) is edited where the change originates and mirrored manually to the sibling shell until a cross-shell drift gate exists. Owner: AlembicPlugin window. Drift check: deferred to the CC2 distribution sub-wave together with the marketplace decision; until then any cross-shell edit must name both shells in its commit message.
provenance.hostWordingDebt: Plugin name, description, keywords, skill bodies, and the bin/alembic-codex-start.mjs filename still carry Codex-era identity wording. Renaming is a user-visible namespace change owned by CC2/CC3 (and SN5 for the lib/codex rename); deliberately not changed here.
